name: transitions
title: Transitions
description: Entrance animations when an element scrolls into view: fade, slide-left / -right / -top / -bottom, rotate, zoom, zoom-out, blur, combinable, with duration, delay, easing, distance, stagger. Use "transition" in any component's data (attributes on its own root element, no wrapper; on <div class="column"> inside columns), this component as a wrapper for groups, or data-transition="…" on any element. Played with the Web Animations API, so the element's own CSS is never overwritten; respects prefers-reduced-motion.
